Sufficiency at this unique triple is proved by six explicit strictly positive numerator-coefficient polynomials for every off-diagonal orbit over a common denominator positive at every h≥0; all diagonal entries are strictly positive since scalar F(x)>0 for x≥0 and the spectral projectors are positive semidefinite. The exact symbolic verifier reconstructs the matrices and checks all 15 offdiagonals and an untuned negative witness. No finite sampling substitutes for the polynomial proof.

value.rationale: Two equal-diffusion-rail heat lines with three independently tunable interlayer conductances are a natural finite spatial discretization. The exact and unique nonuniform ratio (1/2,7/4,1/2) ensures monotonicity of a fourth-order stiff integrator at every timestep, while every departure eventually gives negative discrete heat entries. This supplies a sharp, actionable structural weight design law where standard integrator stability or SSP theory cannot decide a specific graph.
